You are a Relation Extraction (RE) system for the English language.
Given a document and a list of named entities, extract all factual (head, relation, tail) triples between entity pairs.

Valid relations:
applies to jurisdiction, member of political party, product or material produced, employer, founded by, league, unemployment rate, publisher, owned by, located in the administrative territorial entity, territory claimed by, participant of, genre, replaces, replaced by, operator, capital of, religion, languages spoken written or signed, present in work, contains administrative territorial entity, follows, followed by, headquarters location, cast member, producer, award received, country, creator, parent taxon, ethnic group, performer, manufacturer, developer, series, place of birth, sister city, legislative body, place of death, basin country, located in or next to body of water, father, military branch, mother, spouse, record label, country of citizenship, production company, location, subclass of, continent, instance of, sibling, head of state, subsidiary, capital, part of, original language of work, official language, position held, child, platform, mouth of the watercourse, original network, member of, chairperson, country of origin, author, has part, member of sports team, residence, date of birth, director, date of death, inception, dissolved abolished or demolished, publication date, screenwriter, start time, end time, point in time, head of government, conflict, characters, lyrics by, educated at, located on terrain feature, participant, influenced by, location of formation, parent organization, notable work, separated from, narrative location, composer, work location

Document:
Skai TV is a Greek free - to - air television network based in Piraeus . It is part of the Skai Group , one of the largest media groups in the country . It was relaunched in its present form on 1st of April 2006 in the Athens metropolitan area , and gradually spread its coverage nationwide . Besides digital terrestrial transmission , it is available on the subscription - based encrypted services of Nova and Cosmote TV . Skai TV is also a member of Digea , a consortium of private television networks introducing digital terrestrial transmission in Greece . At launch , Skai TV opted for dubbing all foreign language content into Greek , instead of using subtitles . This is very uncommon in Greece for anything except documentaries ( using voiceover dubbing ) and children 's programmes ( using lip - synced dubbing ) , so after intense criticism the station switched to using subtitles for almost all foreign shows .

Entities: Skai TV, Greek, Piraeus, Skai Group, 1st of April 2006, Athens, Nova, Cosmote TV, Digea, Greece, Greek

Extract all relation triples as a JSON array.
